title: 第19章 危坡逢玄貂 荒林拾翠玉第20章 乱石鏖坚兽 暮影载归人
lines: 二人自石坳内动身，两人踏着愈发清亮的晨光，继续朝着翠影高台南侧缓步前行。
林间青石铺就的坡地连绵起伏，原本遮天蔽日的古木愈发稀疏，阳光毫无遮挡地洒落，将周身草木镀上一层暖金。低矮蕨类植物贴着地面生长，叶片上残留的晨露滚落，砸在青石上碎成细小水珠，平添几分清新意趣。
李紫云背负箭囊，手持铁木弓走在罗止正身侧，目光机敏地扫过沿途草木。罗止正则手持盘根铁木枪走在前方半步，枪杆稳稳垂落，周身气息内敛，却始终保持着高度警惕，凡级二阶初期的灵气悄然铺开，感知着周遭数丈内的一切动静。
两人并肩前行约莫一里路，地势陡然向上抬升，形成一处陡峭的青石陡坡。坡上草木更为稀疏，唯有缝隙间扎根着耐旱的杂草，远远望去，整片坡地光秃秃的，视线反倒比先前开阔数倍。
罗止正抬手示意李紫云停下，眉头微凝，压低声音道：“陡坡地势空旷，极易暴露行踪，咱们放慢脚步，小心探查。”
李紫云轻轻颔首，将铁木弓握得更紧，指尖悄然搭在箭囊边缘，随时可取箭备战。
两人一前一后，踩着青石缝隙向上攀爬，脚步轻缓，尽量不发出半点声响。刚爬到陡坡中段，罗止正忽然顿住脚步，鼻尖轻嗅，眸色微微一沉。
空气中除了草木清气，还萦绕着一丝极淡的腥甜气息，绝非寻常草木所能散发。
罗止正周身灵气瞬间绷紧，枪身横于身前，侧首看向身旁李紫云，气息压得极低，神色凝重道：“小心，附近有灵兽出没。”
李紫云心头一紧，身形微伏，目光快速扫视四周，最终定格在陡坡上方一处乱石凹地的石缝洞口。
凹地中央岩壁向内凹陷，裂出一道幽深狭窄的石缝，正是灵兽盘踞的洞口，那缕若有若无的腥甜气息，尽数从洞口飘散而出。日光落在凹凸岩块之上，光影交错，一道小巧黑影正蛰伏在洞口边缘，气息隐匿得几乎无法察觉。
罗止正脚步微侧，将李紫云护在身后些许，枪尖微抬，灵气缓缓铺开探查，神情肃穆，低声叮嘱道：“气息藏得极深，不要贸然上前，先静观其变。”
李紫云身姿压低，盘根铁木箭已然扣紧弓弦，弓身紧绷，眼神锐利锁定洞口黑影，沉稳应道：“好。”
两人屏息凝神片刻，洞口蛰伏的黑影缓缓抬首，一双阴冷竖瞳骤然亮起，凶戾之气翻涌，死死盯住闯入领地的二人。
正是玄影绒貂，凡级二阶初期灵兽。
此兽体长约莫半米，通体覆着乌黑油亮的厚实密绒，皮毛蓬松顺滑，远看如同一团灵动的黑影，鼻尖与耳尖缀着一抹极淡的银灰，竖瞳阴冷锐利，泛着暗紫色寒光。四肢短健有力，锋利爪尖隐于绒毛之下，泛着森冷金属光泽，一条蓬松粗壮的长尾拖在身后，几乎占据体长小半，正轻扫着洞口碎石。
玄影绒貂守在洞口，将二人视作入侵外敌，头颅微微压低，喉间滚出细碎低吼，周身灵气骤然紧绷，蓄势待发。
玄影绒貂率先发难，它蹬紧洞口岩石，身形骤然爆速冲出，化作一道模糊黑影短距掠出。
正是瞬影突袭。
黑影径直扑向罗止正胸腹要害，裹挟着刚猛凌厉的冲势，悍然撞来。罗止正神色一凛，灵气尽数灌注枪身，稳住身形横枪格挡，沉闷撞击声响起，绒貂重重撞在枪杆之上，周身厚绒自行卸去大半冲击，皮毛毫无损伤。罗止正只觉一股刚猛反震之力顺着枪杆猛冲而来，握枪的手掌瞬间发麻，虎口隐隐胀痛，身躯也被这股巨力震得向后微退半步。
玄影绒貂借着冲撞的力道，它粗壮蓬松的长尾裹挟灵气猛然扬起，朝着罗止正握枪的手腕狠狠横扫。
正是绒尾扫击。
它攻势迅猛，长尾裹挟着刚猛劲风横扫而来，意欲搅乱罗止正握枪的架势。罗止正手腕急旋，抽枪后撤侧身避让，神色冷静，脚步轻错间堪堪避开凌厉尾袭，枪身横护身侧，时刻防备灵兽下一轮反扑。
李紫云抓住转瞬即逝的战机，身姿稳立，松开弓弦，盘根铁木箭裹挟劲风直射玄影绒貂身躯。可箭矢落在厚实坚韧的皮毛之上，当即被韧性皮肉弹开，连表层绒毛都无法破开。
李紫云眉梢微蹙，轻声开口道：“箭矢无法穿透它的皮毛。”
玄影绒貂受激发出尖锐啸声，身形再度暴起疾冲，径直锁定罗止正袭来，周身灵气尽数汇聚于交错獠牙之间，锋锐气息翻涌，直取其周身要害。
这正是锐齿绞噬。
罗止正眼神一凝，当即沉腰卸力，横转枪杆竖挡身前，死死封死对方近身绞噬的路线。
纵然被枪杆阻拦，玄影绒貂依旧凶性不减，借着迅捷身法在乱石间飞速窜跃，不断变换方位轮番突袭，近身绞噬与长尾横扫交替施展，攻势愈发凌厉凶悍。
罗止正持枪稳固防守，始终将李紫云护在身侧，灵气牢牢锁死绒貂动向，沉声说道：“我正面牵制，你寻找破绽伺机出手。”
几番缠斗无果，玄影绒貂眼中闪过狡黠之色，骤然转身折返，一头钻入身后狭窄的巢穴石缝，借着岩壁缝隙快速穿梭闪避。
正是石隙遁藏。
它身形在狭小石缝间灵活穿行，眨眼便彻底隐匿无踪，只余下洞口淡淡的腥甜气息，显然打算蛰伏于巢穴深处，等待时机再度偷袭。
罗止正持枪前探半步，眉头微蹙，目光紧盯着幽深石缝，沉声开口道：“它躲回巢穴之中了。”
李紫云缓缓松弦，将盘根铁木箭收回箭囊，身姿微侧，目光依旧紧锁洞口。
没过多久，岩壁缝隙间黑影微动，玄影绒貂并未走远，借着石隙遮挡悄然挪动身形，自石缝侧边的窄缝中悄然探出半个身躯，气息再度收敛到极致，依靠疾影潜踪的身法隐藏踪迹，静静等候出手良机。
罗止正灵气微沉，周身气息再度绷紧，枪尖斜指地面，时刻防备着暗处突袭，低声道：“它没有离开，还在附近窥伺，不要松懈。”
话音刚落，石缝黑影骤然窜出，依旧是爆发极致短距冲速，携着凌厉扑杀之势袭来。
这一次它改变了路线，不再直冲正面的罗止正，转而绕向侧面，企图绕过防守，直取一旁的李紫云。森寒獠牙外露，已然催动锐齿绞噬，准备近身撕裂皮肉。
李紫云神色一凝，脚下轻撤拉开距离，同时迅速抽箭搭弓，盘根铁木弓瞬间拉满。
罗止正反应极快，踏步横身拦截，盘根铁木枪横扫而出，硬生生截断灵兽突进路线，沉声道：“我来拦截，你伺机寻找防御薄弱之处！”
content_en:
The two set off from the stone col, and continued to walk slowly towards the south side of Cuiying Plateau in the increasingly clear morning light.
The slopes paved with bluestones in the forest are undulating, and the ancient trees that originally blocked the sky are becoming increasingly sparse. The sun shines through without any obstruction, coating the surrounding vegetation with a layer of warm gold. Low ferns grow close to the ground, and the morning dew remaining on the leaves rolls down and breaks into tiny water droplets on the bluestone, adding a bit of freshness and interest.
Li Ziyun carried a quiver on his back and walked beside Luo Zhizheng with an ironwood bow in his hand, his eyes keenly scanning the vegetation along the way. Luo Zhizheng was walking half a step ahead with a coiled iron-wood spear in his hand. The barrel of the spear was lowered steadily. His aura was restrained, but he always maintained a high degree of vigilance. The aura of the early second-level mortal level quietly spread out, sensing all movements within a few feet around him.
The two walked side by side for about a mile, when the terrain suddenly rose upwards, forming a steep bluestone slope. The vegetation on the slope is even sparser, with only drought-resistant weeds taking root in the gaps. Looking from a distance, the entire slope is bare, but the line of sight is several times wider than before.
Luo Zhizheng raised his hand to signal Li Ziyun to stop, frowned slightly, and said in a low voice: "The terrain on the steep slope is open and it is easy to expose the whereabouts. Let's slow down and explore carefully."
Li Ziyun nodded slightly, held the ironwood bow tighter, and placed his fingertips quietly on the edge of the quiver, ready to retrieve arrows at any time to prepare for battle.
The two of them climbed up, one behind the other, stepping on the gaps between the bluestones. Their steps were gentle and they tried not to make the slightest sound. Just as he climbed to the middle of the steep slope, Luo Zhizheng suddenly stopped, sniffed lightly with the tip of his nose, and his eyes darkened slightly.
In addition to the fresh air of vegetation, there is also a very faint smell of fishy sweetness lingering in the air, which is definitely not what ordinary vegetation can emit.
Luo Zhizheng's spiritual energy tightened instantly, the gun was placed horizontally in front of him, he looked sideways at Li Ziyun beside him, his breath was very low, and he said solemnly: "Be careful, there are spiritual beasts nearby."
Li Ziyun's heart tightened, and he crouched slightly. His eyes quickly scanned the surroundings, and finally settled on the entrance of a stone crevice in a rocky depression above the steep slope.
The central rock wall of the depression sunk inwards, creating a deep and narrow stone crevice, which was the entrance of the cave where the spiritual beast was entrenched. The sun fell on the uneven rock, and the light and shadow intertwined. A small black shadow was dormant at the edge of the cave entrance, its aura so hidden that it was almost undetectable.
Luo Zhizheng stepped slightly sideways, guarding Li Ziyun behind him a little, raised the tip of his spear slightly, slowly spread out his spiritual energy to explore, with a solemn look on his face, and whispered: "The aura is hidden very deep, don't rush forward, wait and see what happens."
Li Ziyun lowered his posture, the iron wood arrows were already tightened on the bowstring, the bow was tense, his eyes were sharply focused on the black shadow at the entrance of the cave, and he responded calmly: "Okay."
The two of them held their breath and concentrated for a moment. The dark shadow lurking at the entrance of the cave slowly raised its head. A pair of cold vertical pupils suddenly lit up, and a ferocious aura surged, staring at the two people who broke into the territory.
It is Xuanying Velvet Marten, an early stage second-level mortal spirit beast.
The body of this beast is about half a meter long, and its entire body is covered with thick and shiny black velvet. The fur is fluffy and smooth. From a distance, it looks like a moving black shadow. The tip of its nose and ears are dotted with a very light silver gray. Its vertical pupils are cold and sharp, glowing with a dark purple cold light. The limbs are short and strong, and the tips of the sharp claws are hidden under the fur, glowing with a cold metallic luster. A fluffy and thick long tail is trailing behind it, taking up almost half of the body length, and is sweeping the gravel at the entrance of the cave.
The Xuanying velvet guarded the entrance of the cave, regarding the two of them as invading foreign enemies. He lowered his head slightly and roared softly from his throat. The aura around his body suddenly tightened and he was ready to attack.
The Xuanying velvet was the first to attack. It stepped on the rock at the entrance of the cave and suddenly rushed out at an explosive speed, turning into a blurry black shadow and flying out in a short distance.
It's the instant shadow attack.
The black shadow rushed straight towards Luo Zhizheng's chest and abdomen, carrying a fierce and fierce momentum, and slammed into him. Luo Zhizheng looked stern, and poured all his spiritual energy into the gun body. He stabilized his body and blocked the gun. A dull impact sounded. The velvet hit the gun barrel heavily, and the thick velvet all over its body took off most of the impact, leaving no damage to its fur. Luo Zhizheng only felt a strong counter-shock force rushing down the barrel of the gun. The palm of his hand holding the gun instantly became numb.
The Xuanying Velvet Marten used the force of the collision to raise its thick and fluffy long tail, wrapped in spiritual energy, and swiped hard at Luo Zhi's wrist that was holding the gun.
It's the velvet tail sweep.
It attacked quickly and fiercely, its long tail carrying the strong wind as it swept forward, intending to disrupt Luo Zhi's posture of holding the gun. Luo Zhizheng turned his wrist sharply, drew his gun and retreated sideways to avoid it. His expression was calm, and he could avoid the fierce tail attack with a slight stagger of his steps. The gun body was placed horizontally to protect his side, always preparing for the next round of counterattack by the spirit beast.
Li Ziyun seized the fleeting opportunity, stood firm, loosened the bow string, and shot the ironwood arrow directly at Xuan Ying's velvet body with the strong wind. But the arrow landed on the thick and tough fur, and was immediately bounced away by the tough flesh, unable to even break through the surface fluff.
Li Ziyun frowned slightly and said softly: "The arrow cannot penetrate its fur."
The Xuanying velvet was aroused and let out a sharp whistle. It surged forward again, locked onto Luo Zhizheng and attacked directly. All the spiritual energy in its body gathered between the interlaced fangs, and its sharp aura surged and struck directly at his vital points.
This is what sharp teeth bite.
Luo Zhizheng's eyes narrowed, and he immediately lowered his waist to release his strength, turned the gun horizontally and vertically to block the opponent's path, blocking the opponent's path of close attack.
Even though it was blocked by the barrel of the gun, the Xuanying velvet remained ferocious. It used its quick movements to jump quickly among the rocks, constantly changing its position and taking turns to attack. It alternated between close-in choke and long-tail sweep, and its offensive became more fierce and fierce.
Luo Zhizheng was holding a gun to defend firmly, always protecting Li Ziyun by his side, his spiritual energy firmly locked on the movement of the mink, and said in a deep voice: "I will contain you from the front, you look for loopholes and wait for the opportunity to take action."
After several struggles to no avail, a cunning look flashed in Xuan Ying's velvet marten's eyes, and he suddenly turned around and headed back, diving into the narrow stone crevice of the lair behind him and quickly dodging through the cracks in the rock wall.
It is to hide in the stone gap.
It flexibly moved through the narrow cracks in the rocks, and disappeared completely in the blink of an eye, leaving only a faint fishy-sweet smell at the entrance of the cave. It was obviously planning to hibernate deep in the lair, waiting for the opportunity to attack again.
Luo Zhi took half a step forward with his gun, frowning slightly, staring at the deep stone crevices, and said in a deep voice: "It hid back in its lair."
Li Ziyun slowly loosened the string and put the ironwood arrow back into the quiver. His posture was slightly sideways, but his eyes were still fixed on the entrance of the hole.
Not long after, the black shadow moved slightly in the cracks in the rock wall. The black shadow velvet did not go far. It moved quietly through the stone cracks and quietly stretched out half of its body from the narrow crack on the side of the stone cracks. Its breath was once again convergent to the extreme. It relied on the sneaking skills of Jiying to hide its traces and quietly waited for the right opportunity to take action.
Luo Zhizheng's spiritual energy sank slightly, and the aura around his body became tense again. He pointed the tip of his gun diagonally at the ground, always on guard against surprise attacks in the dark, and whispered: "It hasn't left, it's still watching nearby, don't relax."
As soon as he finished speaking, a black shadow suddenly emerged from the cracks in the stone, still bursting into extreme short-distance sprinting speed, and attacking with a fierce killing force.
This time it changed its route, no longer going straight towards Luo Zhizheng in the front, but instead going around to the side, trying to bypass the defense and go straight to Li Ziyun on the side. Senhan's fangs were exposed, and he was already using his sharp teeth to twist and bite, preparing to tear the flesh at close range.
Li Ziyun's expression condensed, and he moved his feet slightly to distance himself. At the same time, he quickly drew an arrow and nocked the bow, and the iron-wood bow was fully drawn in an instant.
Luo Zhizheng reacted very quickly. He stepped sideways to intercept, and swept out the iron-wood spear, cutting off the spirit beast's advance route. He said solemnly: "I will intercept, and you wait for opportunities to find weak points in the defense!"
title_en: Chapter 19: Encountering a black mink on a dangerous slope, picking up jade in a deserted forest Chapter 20: A rocky beast, the dusk shadow carries people back
